subject: Coordination: Full interview loop for Sanjay Patel — availability & panel sequencing
messages:
From: Taylor Morgan <taylor.morgan@recruitr.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@gmail.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate ready for full loop — Sanjay Patel (L4 SWE)

Hi Soojin,

Sanjay (attached resume) is excited to move into a full virtual onsite. Hes currently in PST and prefers afternoons (post-1pm PT) on weekdays. Hes flexible next week (6/17-6/21) for a 4-slot panel + 30m debrief.

Quick notes from recruiter:
- Strong systems background, will need one deep design and one coding slot
- Prefers back-to-back slots if possible to reduce context switching
- Needs at least a 15m buffer before the debrief to grab lunch/collect thoughts

Could you confirm Redwood interviewer availability and an order that makes sense for the team? Ill hold candidate availability until EOD today.

Thanks,
Taylor
Recruitr — Technical Recruiting
attachments: Sanjay_Patel_Resume.pdf
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate ready for full loop — Sanjay Patel (L4 SWE)

Thanks Taylor — looping in the full loop owners.

Team, can you share availability windows next week (6/17-6/21) between 1pm-5pm PT? Proposed structure that balances depth and motivation:
1) 60m System Design (Laura)
2) 45m Coding (Jonas)
3) 45m Product/Behavioral + Context (Kim)
4) 30m Deep-dive architecture follow-up (optional overflow)
+ 30m debrief (owned by on-call interviewer)

Notes/constraints:
- Candidate wants back-to-back slots; Id like to preserve a 15–20m buffer before debrief for candidate reset.
- If we run two coding pieces back-to-back (code + architecture), we should ensure Jonas has the morning prep window.

I attached a short runbook for logistics (full_loop_runbook.pdf) and will generate calendar invites once you confirm concrete windows.

If anyone prefers a different ordering, say moving product earlier, call it out here.

Cheers,
Soojin
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
attachments: full_loop_runbook.pdf

Subject: Re: Candidate ready for full loop — Sanjay Patel (L4 SWE)

Soojin — I can do 6/18 or 6/19, 1:30–2:30pm PT for design. Prefer to run design first while energys high. A couple of constraints:
- Im mentoring a candidate panel at 3pm on 6/19, so I cant go later that day.
- If we place design first, please ensure the coding slot is immediately after (no >10m gap) so the candidate stays warmed up.

Order ok with me: Design -> Coding -> Prod -> Optional architecture. Happy to lead debrief if Jonas prefers to write notes.

Laura
Staff SWE, Backend Platforms

Hi Sanjay / Taylor — thanks for the notes. Proposed schedule (all PT):

Tue, 18 Jun 2029
- 13:30–14:30 PT: System Design — Laura Bennett (60m)
- 14:30–15:15 PT: Coding — Jonas Weber (45m)
- 15:15–16:00 PT: Product/Behavioral — Kimberly Park (45m)
- 16:00–16:30 PT: Optional arch follow-up (if needed)
- 16:50–17:20 PT: Debrief (30m) — Laura to own debrief; 20m buffer before debrief

Action items:
- Taylor: confirm candidate can do Tue 6/18 afternoon (candidate preferred week is fine).
- Jonas: please confirm you can be on the 14:30 coding slot and will prepare the live problem (I will allocate a private room).
- Kimberly: confirm product slot ok.
- Team: Ill send calendar invites + attach the candidate packet and the welcome ics.

Notes about timezones: Sanjay is PST; internal interviewers east coast should appear on their calendar as 16:30–17:30 ET (please double-check). I added a 20m break before the debrief per candidate preference.

Attaching: full_loop_runbook.pdf, candidate_welcome.ics

Thanks all — Ill push invites once Jonas/Kimberly confirm.

Best,
Soojin
